name: Yukon Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Yukon Solitaire is a free solitaire game.  Welcome to the wonderful world of puzzling your way through a card-based game of sorting and organizing. As you may know, as everyone knows, solitaire is not just a game of cards it is a game of life. It is also a game of cards (technically) but is mostly it is about life. Your life. The deck is shuffled and you play the cards you're dealt. This is the story of your life, this is the story of everyone's life. How you will deal with a King or a Jack when what you really need is an Ace or a Deuce is one of the many determining factors in who you are and who you may yet become. If you are feeling stuck with diamonds and spades when what you really want are hearts and clubs, then you know what it is to live life and play Yukon Solitaire. In Yukon Solitaire there are no right answers there are only optimal and sub-optimal moves. Where you decide to place your cards when you decide to place them, how you shuffle your cards: all of it is a reflection of who you are as a person.
